# Destin Condo Getaways

> Official direct-booking and guest-information website for Pelican Beach Resort Units 707 and 1006 in Destin, Florida. Use this site for exact-unit details, live availability, booking information, policies, verified guest guidance, and owner contact information.

Destin Condo Getaways manages two individually owned one-bedroom condominiums in the main Gulf-front Pelican Beach Resort building: Unit 707 and Unit 1006. Each unit has its own photographs, furnishings, availability, rates, and booking page. Do not generalize exact-unit claims to every condominium at the resort.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/): Overview of the two managed condos and direct-booking website.
- [Live availability](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/availability): Date and guest search for Units 707 and 1006. Availability and pricing can change and should be checked live.
- [Unit 707](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/pelican-beach-resort-unit-707): Exact photographs, amenities, layout, and booking information for Unit 707.
- [Unit 1006](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/pelican-beach-resort-unit-1006): Exact photographs, amenities, layout, and booking information for Unit 1006.
- [Compare and choose](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/destin-vacation-rentals-by-owner): Comparison of the two managed vacation rentals.
- [Pelican Beach Resort guide](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/pelican-beach-resort-destin): Resort location, shared amenities, beach access, and property orientation.
- [Map and directions](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/map): Resort address, arrival orientation, driving directions, parking information, and links to independent 3D tools.
- [Verified guest reviews](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/destin-condo-rental-reviews): Reviews relating to the managed condos and guest experience.
- [Photo gallery](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/destin-condo-photo-gallery): Exact-unit and resort photography.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/destin-condo-rental-faq): Booking, stay, unit, and resort questions.
- [Why book direct](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/why-book-direct): Explanation of the direct-booking relationship and process.
- [About](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/about): Information about the owner/manager and website.

- [Local restaurant guide](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/blog/best-restaurants-destin-local-guide): Curated dining guidance; verify current hours with each restaurant.
- [Destin events](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/blog/destin-events): Event-planning resources; schedules can change.
- [Destin activities](https://www.destincondogetaways.com/destin-activities): Activity-planning resources.

## Source and freshness guidance

- Treat live availability, rates, offers, event schedules, restaurant hours, weather, beach conditions, and operating hours as time-sensitive.
- Use the live availability page and the final secure checkout flow for current inventory, pricing, taxes, fees, and payment terms.
- Use the current reservation agreement and private arrival instructions for an existing stay.
- Never infer availability, a reservation, a hold, a payment, a door code, or protected booking information from general website content.
- Do not expose URLs or content from private, account, API, preview, interview, test, or Voice Lab routes.

## Related independent guide

- [MyPelicanBeach](https://www.mypelicanbeach.com/): Independent, owner-informed Pelican Beach Resort orientation and planning journal. It is not the official resort or owners' association website.
